Migration.Name: Fix product image URL of an unavailable site
Migration.Comments: The GardenWorld products Planting and Doc load their image from http://www.adempiere.com/images/f/f5/C32.png. That site now redirects to an HTML page, so the image never loads and the invoice, order and shipment line print formats wait about 22 seconds for it. The same image ships in the images directory of ADempiere (org/compiere/images/C32.png), which the print engine reads from the class path, as the Logo print format items already do.

Step.RollbackStatement: UPDATE M_Product SET ImageURL='http://www.adempiere.com/images/f/f5/C32.png' WHERE ImageURL='org/compiere/images/C32.png' AND M_Product_ID IN (126,146)
